amends.reason: Bind the independently validated terminal R/S/E scale-up panel; freeze raw-LOO temperature and nucleus semantics, schema-8 token-control evidence, a held-out staged candidate campaign, repository-global generation safety, and an acyclic publication firewall before any registered candidate generation.

terminal_scale_up_authority.required_revalidation: The terminal validator must reconstruct the exact registry, ordered R/S/E artifacts, and recursive predecessor-receipt chain before any registered generation authority is accepted.

raw_loo_top_p_semantics.research_boundary: Predictor-corrector sampling is deferred because the reviewed reference implementation has an active pc_temperature defect; it is not part of this frozen campaign.

registered_generation_campaign.candidate_id_semantics: A candidate ID identifies only one terminal scale-up training checkpoint; stage, temperature, and top-p belong to config and attempt IDs.
registered_generation_campaign.nfe_definition: one full backbone forward evaluation per reverse step
registered_generation_campaign.search_limitation: Stage A greedily retains two of four temperatures at p=1 before testing top-p interactions; this is a lean interaction search, not exhaustive optimization over all 36 settings.

primary_claim: A locked UDLM checkpoint and sampling configuration beats the audited local GenMol MDLM checkpoint on the released-compatible de-novo metric gate.

final_operating_point.nfe_definition: one full backbone forward evaluation per reverse step

selection_firewall.final_retry_policy: No selection, tuning, deletion, replacement, or retry based on a final-seed outcome; infrastructure failures remain disclosed and make the registered three-seed claim incomplete until separately adjudicated.

validity.inputs: pooled valid counts over pooled requested counts

uniqueness.inputs: three seed-level uniqueness fractions per method

quality.inputs: three seed-level quality fractions per method

diversity.inputs: three seed-level diversity scores per method

uncertainty_gates.forbidden_method: row bootstrap that re-deduplicates resampled molecule identities

decision.pass_condition: Every point-estimate gate and every one-sided uncertainty gate passes for the one pre-locked candidate.
decision.failure_condition: Any failed or unverifiable gate, provenance binding, final operating-point requirement, or selection-firewall requirement prevents the superiority claim.

claim_boundaries.warm_start: Passing supports only a locked operational MDLM-to-UDLM continuation-system claim on these molecular metrics. It does not isolate diffusion-method causality and is not an inference-speed claim.
claim_boundaries.scratch: Passing supports a locked single-training-trajectory checkpoint comparison. One training seed does not establish population-level diffusion-method superiority.
claim_boundaries.method_only_requirement: A causal method claim additionally requires a from-scratch matched training panel or an equal-extra-update MDLM continuation control under a separately frozen protocol.
claim_boundaries.uncertainty_limitation: Welch intervals use only three generation seeds per method and condition on each locked checkpoint; they do not measure training-seed uncertainty.
